p.i: loci consolatoria,de amplissimis bonis spiritualibus & cœlestibus, quæ generaliter omnibus qui Euangeliū re ceperint,tum in hac uita,tum post hanc uitā ad extre-mum iudiciū sunt proposita. Quādo itaq; ait,Et seruos suos uocabit nomine alio : respicit quidem ad id quod dixit,incredulos relisturos nomen suum execrabile: at principaliter significat,nouum populū eligendum,qui non referet uel iactabit nomen à Iudæis aut Iudæorum patriarchis,sed potius nouum ducet nomen à Christo, dicenturq; Christiani.quæ interpretatio comprobatur ijs quæ leguntur Act.ii,item Act.26. 1.Petri 4.ubi eius appellationis nouæ ratio redditur.Si bene aduertimus, respicit ad locum sequentem,in quo de abrogatione le-gis differitur.Cum uerò addit, Qui benedixerit in terra sibi,&c.innuit,ab illo populo alienam fore omnem idololatriam & superstitiosos cultus : quod quidē non citra occupationem uidetur adiectum.Cogitassent for-te aliqui ex Iudæis:Eligentur ergo gentiles idololatriæ dediti,& à uero cultu remotissimi:quod quidem ualde absurdum uidetur. Atqui satisfit istis,dicendo,cligēdos quidem fore gentiles, sed qui idololatriam prorsus reijcient,atq; in uero cultu unius Dei perseuerabunt.quā-uis multò rectissimè hæc uerba de extrema illa perfe-ctione,quæ post hanc uitā et peracto extremo iudicio, Ecclesiæ continget,accipientur: ubi uidelicet electi omnes Deum iugiter sine errore ullo laudabūt ac prædicabūt.q interpretatio nō mediocriter cōfirmatur ijs quæ

main_text.p: cligēdos [?] is printed as "cligēdos"; the first letter may be a damaged e.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "cligēdos" (line 20) is printed as shown and may read "eligēdos"; "Act.ii" (line 11) may be a damaged numeral; "būt.q" at the start of line 27 is the end of "prædicabūt" and is copied as printed. Line-end breaks without a printed hyphen ("terra", "reijcient", "prædicabūt") are joined whole. No marginal notes or running-head number printed. The text ends at the last full line; "sequun-" is taken as the catchword.
